# Spacer

> A Rust CLI and read-only terminal browser for organizing local development projects into spaces.

The current application tracks directories and change records in JSON. Git
repository/worktree operations exist in the core library but are not integrated
into the CLI or TUI. Starting or finishing a change only updates tracking.
Workspace resolution uses SPACER_ROOT or the current directory, without ancestor
search. The documentation describes the committed application behavior.
